question: Can a separately versioned C11 kernel reproduce the existing NumPy pointwise safe-Lab evaluation semantics exactly for Velvia 50, Portra 400 and Ektar 100 while retaining the U7.6I material CPU advantage?

parent_negative.diagnosis: When skin_protect is positive, the existing NumPy guardrail promotes the complete post-neutral out_ab array to binary64 before skin blending and chroma-cap arithmetic, then casts once to float32. The v2 C kernel retained binary32 through those stages. Velvia 50 alone exercised the cap on 156 preview pixels, producing a maximum 1.9073486328125e-6 Lab difference.

required_native_semantics.pre_skin_arithmetic: binary32 with the existing operation order
required_native_semantics.positive_skin_protect_transition: promote post-neutral out_ab and source_ab to binary64 before skin blending
required_native_semantics.post_skin_chroma_cap: binary64 output norm, scale, smoothstep knee and final multiplication; source-derived cap remains binary32 before binary64 division
required_native_semantics.output_cast: one binary64-to-binary32 cast per a/b channel after the cap stage
required_native_semantics.skin_protect_zero: retain the existing binary32 path because the NumPy skin block is skipped

stop_rules: Do not alter the Python oracle, source, preview geometry, style parameters, guardrails, thread count or gates after this freeze.
Do not reinterpret U7.6I as passing; U7.6J is a distinct kernel version with an explicit binary64 compatibility stage.
If exact parity fails, close this implementation without tolerance, compiler-flag, source, dimension, parameter or thread-count rescue.
A pass opens only one separately frozen full-chain composition test; it does not authorize product default replacement or a stock-response claim.
claim_ceiling: Local Windows/MSVC CPU evidence for a separately versioned exact implementation of the pointwise Lab subset of three non-calibrated Look Approximations at 0.999MP; not a complete renderer, stock response, stock distinguishability, calibration or product promotion.
